We maintain a transparent approach in showing revisions to UK gross domestic product (GDP) estimates by publishing real-time estimates of GDP, alongside our data vintages, and by providing a timely assessment of these revisions.

However, the relative mean absolute revision (RMAR), which takes into account the revision to GDP in relation to the size of the initial estimate of growth, shows that the latest periods do not differ much from the pattern seen over the past three decades.
